mentions.name: Functional Universe (FU)
mentions.description: A modeling framework and experimental codebase that treats systems as sequences of irreversible functional transitions rather than objects evolving against a global clock. It aligns with ideas from quantum mechanics (aggregation vs collapse), relativity (proper time), and distributed systems (event-driven causality), and is useful for thinking clearly about time, causality, and scheduling in real systems.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on something we call the Functional Universe (FU), a modeling framework and experimental codebase that treats systems as sequences of irreversible functional transitions, rather than objects evolving against a global clock.
